dict.string: Longhand records the conversation in the room so it can transcribe it on this Mac.
Longhand records the sound your Mac plays only while Computer audio is on, so it can transcribe the people on a call.
Longhand reads new recordings in the watched folder and saves notes in the folder that you choose in Settings.
